NOT A JOKE FOR ONCE

A little something from me

Alisha,

Happy belated birthday! I know this wish is late, but I hope your year is filled with the kind of happiness that stays, people who genuinely care, unexpected good news and countless reasons to smile.

Thank you for being your wonderfully chaotic self. Keep being funny, dramatic, unapologetically you and the person who makes ordinary moments feel memorable.

I hope you never forget how appreciated you are. You deserve beautiful things, lovely memories and a year that treats you kindly.

Here's to more laughter, more nonsense, more memories and many more birthdays to celebrate. I'm glad I get to know you. ♡

With lots of love,
Your favourite troublemaker
